response.sql: WITH signal_stats AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as baseline FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), rfi_groups AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'NO_STATUS') as rfi_status, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'NO_STATUS')), filtered_groups AS (SELECT rg.rfi_status, rg.avg_modindex, ss.baseline FROM rfi_groups rg CROSS JOIN signal_stats ss WHERE rg.avg_modindex > ss.baseline), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as kept_mean FROM filtered_groups) SELECT fg.rfi_status, fg.avg_modindex, fg.avg_modindex - fg.baseline as above_baseline, fg.avg_modindex - km.kept_mean as diff_from_kept_mean FROM filtered_groups fg CROSS JOIN kept_mean km ORDER BY fg.avg_modindex DESC
